status.description: completed: the assignment was delivered. needs_input: essential input is missing (fill question). blocked: a runtime refusal or external condition stopped the work (fill blockers).

summary.description: The report for the parent in prose: what was done, which files changed, what was verified and how, remaining caveats. Never a plan or a promise of future work.

key_findings.description: Short facts the parent must know, one per entry.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made where the assignment was ambiguous.

verification.description: Commands or checks actually run in this turn with their observed result, e.g. 'npm test: 210 passed'. Empty when nothing was verified.

code.description: Stable identifier such as computer_use_app_not_approved, stale_browser_tab_claim, debugger_unattached, missing_dependency.

app.description: The exact application name or bundle id for Computer Use refusals; otherwise null.

question.description: When status is needs_input: the exact missing input as one question. Otherwise null.
